20261103WI85106.description: Wisconsin Question 2. Prohibits ordering the closure of places of worship during declared emergencies.
20261103WI85106.summary: This proposed amendment to Wisconsin's constitution would prohibit state and local governments from ordering the closure of places of worship in response to a state of emergency, including a public health emergency.
20261103WI85106.seatName: 2 - Prohibit the closure of places of worship during emergencies

20261103WI85107.description: Wisconsin Question 1. Bars the governor from using a partial veto to create or raise taxes or fees.
20261103WI85107.summary: This proposed amendment to Wisconsin's constitution would prohibit the governor from using a partial veto to create or increase a tax or fee.
20261103WI85107.seatName: 1 - Prohibit Governor's partial veto to create or increase any tax or fee

20261103WI85108.description: Wisconsin Question 3. Prohibits discrimination or preferential treatment based on race or sex.
20261103WI85108.summary: This proposed amendment to Wisconsin's constitution would prohibit governmental entities, public schools and higher education institutions from discriminating or granting preferential treatment on the basis of race, sex, color, ethnicity or national origin.
20261103WI85108.seatName: 3 - Prohibit governmental entities from discriminating or granting preferential treatment
